name: 993 three-runner intake manifold, AlSi10Mg F0 concept
description: Independent concept of a manifold with three offset conical runners and two common flanges to screen AlSi10Mg LPBF. PorscheFanatics and Patrick Motorsports cross-check the PMO FUE PMO 9150 kit, stated as 46 x 42 x 100 mm, three bolts, two parts and a raw aluminum finish; no interface geometry is published.

classification.intended_use: CAD, DfAM, flow, acoustic, pressure and thermal screening; no manufacturing, installation or engine start authorized

provenance.record_license: MIT for the concept, the script and the calculations; no photograph, trademark, illustration or PMO/Porsche geometry redistributed

sources.title: PorscheFanatics - PMO 46 mm manifold for 964/993 engine
sources.notes: Cross-checks the 46 x 42 x 100 mm designation, three bolts, raw aluminum and the 964/993 engine fitment. See SRC-PORSCHEFANATICS-PMO-964-993-46MM-INTAKE-MANIFOLD.

sources.title: Patrick Motorsports - PMO FUE PMO 9150
sources.notes: States the set of two manifolds, 46 x 42 x 100 mm, three bolts, raw aluminum finish and 964/993 3.6-3.8 L Motronic conversions, without drawing or alloy. See SRC-PATRICK-PMO-964-993-46MM-INTAKE-MANIFOLD.

sources.title: EOS Aluminium AlSi10Mg material page
sources.notes: LPBF family and process reference, not proof of the PMO alloy nor an engine allowables map. See SRC-EOS-ALSI10MG-CURRENT-PAGE.

material.grade: generic AlSi10Mg for screening; alloy and temper of the PMO product unknown
material.standard: ASTM F3318 and a program-specific engine specification to be contracted if LPBF is retained

post_processing: complete powder removal through the three open runners
stress relief and heat treatment qualified on representative coupons
build plate cut-off with flange flatness check
machining of both flanges, ports and holes after adding measured machining allowances
deburring, polishing or abrasive finishing of the gas path with verified roughness
particulate cleaning and leak test before any flow test
supplier_requirements: traceable powder, machine, parameters, orientation, lot and recycling
capability on 2 mm walls, inclined runners and 6 mm flanges
support, recoater and distortion simulation before build
CT of the runners and metrology of ports, flanges and future fastenings
porosity, roughness, flatness, leak-tightness and cleanliness contracted
flow, pressure, vibration, thermal cycling and engine dyno tests before vehicle

titanium.galvanic_isolation: Galvanic compatibility of AlSi10Mg with cylinder heads, studs, throttles, gaskets and coatings to be qualified.

known_limits: The 46 x 42 x 100 mm string is not defined by a drawing; its interpretation as diameters and height remains hypothetical.
The F0 spacings, offsets, flanges, thicknesses and absence of holes do not reproduce PMO or Porsche.
The 461.03 g per bank and 922.07 g per pair cannot be compared with any published commercial mass.
The flow at 6,800 rpm, the volumetric efficiency of 0.95 and the loss coefficient of 0.05 are synthetic.
The 1D calculation ignores pulsations, interactions, roughness, plenum, injection, cylinder head conduction, fatigue and backfire.
The STEP proves only a computable BREP and must not be manufactured for an engine.
